api: GitHub REST API (https://api.github.com) plus declared GitHub GraphQL document bindings
scope: Full REST binding expansion against GitHub's pinned OpenAPI description: every documented REST operation is enumerated below with exactly one disposition. The authoritative combined REST plus GraphQL root inventory is generated from internal/connectors/defs/github/sources/github-operation-source-lock.json into .planning/phases/github-parity-extract-r1/GITHUB-COMBINED-OPERATION-LEDGER.json. This binding layer retains REST endpoints and legacy fixed GraphQL documents that back existing streams; it is not the GraphQL completeness denominator. Webhook EVENT payloads (270, under the x-webhooks vendor extension) are excluded from the operation surface by counting policy; the 28 webhook MANAGEMENT operations are ordinary paths entries and are included.
